versions.changelog:
Agent MBTI diagnosis & optimization system initial release:

- Provides a 5-stage framework to diagnose Agent MBTI type, compare with user expectations, and auto-generate configuration modification suggestions.
- Introduces multi-stage process: self-survey, ability test, personality analysis, user needs survey, and config adjustment.
- Defines 16 Agent personality types with core traits and mapping files.
- Includes dedicated JSON files and tools for each stage: surveys, test data, diagnostic engine, and config generator.
- Supports command-line execution for the full diagnosis and tuning pipeline.
